decision: Do not replace the default logged staging implementation, regardless of speed. Finish the declared comparison as a WAL diagnostic, then revert the runtime change.
reason: Real crash controls confirm logged staged rows survive and unlogged rows vanish. Current automated same-ID retries both rebuild staging, but removing durable staged data also removes a manual recovery copy if the original source cannot be replayed. The user requires no loss; the actual replayability of their source has not been established.
retained_work: Crash correctness checks for existing production logged staging and transparent benchmark WAL measurements. Preserve all prototype results, including failures.
scope: This is a stricter recovery-compatibility decision, not a relaxation of the +25/+50 performance gates.
